lines.text: Some filmmakers never make the same movie twice. Others make it again and again.
Fold thirty-six thousand plots onto their two biggest differences: romance to action, and crime to animation.
Ridley Scott's thirty-one films land all over the map. Alien. Gladiator. Black Hawk Down. The Martian. Plot similarity: zero point four eight.
Jason Staythum's forty-three films? Most of them crowd one corner. Crank. The Transporter. The Expendables. Plot similarity: zero point six nine.
Among the biggest stars, Benedict Cumberbatch has the widest range. Jason Staythum, the narrowest.
Also near the top: Paul Walker, Michelle Rodriguez and Vin Diesel. One franchise can typecast a whole cast.
Look up your favorite director. Massive Movie Map.
